title: aragallus bigelowii
intro: Aragallus bigelowii, commonly known as Bigelow's geranium, is a perennial plant native to North America, characterized by its clusters of small, pink or white flowers. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Bigelow's geranium include its ability to stimulate digestion, alleviate menstrual cramps, and exhibit sedative and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Aragallus bigelowii include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
